content: Isal a Pɔl u Tɛsalɔnikà
Atɔŋ, bɛ ŋakwo làkyayöb naa ngyeel abi akà bɛ kà yàkäl yà bunàbun anki.
Wɛɛ, ungö mukipà mpay anà mukito u bul a Filipe, asànaa làyɔb bɛ, Nzam kipɛ ngwal mukàlakyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ ande, uboo a ngwiy a kölàköl.
Ntɔn, ndɛɛl abi kàyàŋàbwaay anki udu a ndiimà, itàkal udu a an'kyän a ŋingyay, itàkal u mbwo a an'kyän a loor.
Wɛɛ Nzam kàkyisyeebà anà kàkyiman bàŋàkwo mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, kyakin bi ya ifàkyään anki ntɔn mupà un'sak akà baar, wɛɛ akà Nzam awafàler mpem abi.
Kyakin, bɛ làkyàyöb, Nzam wà mbäl abi, naa bi kàsyääl anki akà ikikye ndaa alwab baar, itàkal an'kyän muwal bweel.
Bi kàleŋ anki làkoo a baar, itàkal akà bɛ, itàkal akà bumwɛy,
itàkal naa bi ibà antööm a Klistɔ, bi kàlàsiinà anki a ngwal mukal ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b abi. Wɛɛ bi bàkäl aŋàyɔl a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n uboo a bɛ, asànaa maa ufàbööb nde baan ande.
Ntɔn bi kàkäl anà ukwen mbɔɔn akà bɛ, bi kàmɛn naa yà ubwaŋ bi kàlapɛ kà nà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Nzam mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi ŋakwo, ntɔn bɛ làbà bàntal akà bi.
Atɔŋ, bɛ làkyàkayɔbà mpay anà yɔ̈ɔ̈n abi: bi kàsälà mpib anà mwäänà ntɔn mukɔɔn akal buur akà umwɛy ubɔɔ abɛ, waa bi kàlakyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Nzam.
Bɛ làbà ambäl anà Nzam sye: nkääl abi kusà a bɛ, aŋàlàkwikilà, yàkäl yà in'kyɛɛl, yàbalàbal, ikɔ̈ɔ̈n an'pɛl.
Bɛ làkyàyöb naa bi bàkyerà aben akà umwɛy umwey uboo a bɛ. Bi kàkyer asànaa taa anà baan ande ŋakwo,
mukàlalɛɛl, mukàlapà ngwal, anà mukàlalɔ̈ɔ̈m mukal anà nkääl aŋàkwo a Nzam awà kàlabel u Imwol ande anà u làkoo ande.

Kyakin, akà bi, bi ifàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam taaŋ lanswà: mpal bàlakyään bi ndaa a Nzam, bɛ làkyer awem anà làkyey ya, kà asànaa ndaa a mbuur anki, wɛɛ asànaa ndaa a Nzam, ntɔn ya yà ndandaa. Kyakin, ya ifàsal ngwal amu bɛ aŋàlàkwikilà.
Atɔŋ, bɛ làyweel Ikööŋ a Nzam abyà u Yuday, amu Klistɔ Yɛsu. Ntɔn mpay nsil ya làmɛn bɛ akà atɔŋ abɛ ŋakwo, ba sye bàmɛn ya akà Ayudà.
Ba bà baar bàdwä Mwol Yɛsu anà aŋangɔɔm, anà bimɛɛy nkwaaŋ. Nzam un'sak watɛy anà ba. Ba bàŋankir a baar banswà!

Ba bàfàkyer ngwal mukidüüb mbwo muyääm anà baar mpa abà Ayudà manà naa ba bàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈. Abun, ba bàmukwɛy man'be udu a man'be aba taaŋ lanswà, anà u ngöngö, nkyɛl a Nzam ikyer asabweel.
Pɔl akwen mufàman baar a Tɛsalɔnikà
Wɛɛ akà bi, atɔŋ, bi kàkyer akaabà anà bɛ taaŋ làmwɛy, itàkal naa bi ifàmɛɛn anki, bɛ làbà u mpem abi. Bi kàkäl anà ilɛɛm mukàlaman, anà bi kàkyer ngwal mbɔɔn mukwey ya.
Bi kàkwen muyà akà bɛ: mɛ ŋakwo, Pɔl, kàsi mbalà mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ Satanà laa kidüüb nde mbwo.
Abun, nà, isàkal naa kà bɛ anki, abà làkyän abi, un'sak abi, anà ngaal isàkal mpà a làkoo abi kusà a Mwol Yɛsu umpal usàyà nde?
Ɛɛ, bɛ làbà làkoo anà un'sak abi.
